summary: Portrait end-zone game view (2013) with the field in the upper-middle. No qualifying night photo.

files.author: Jbrubins

files.note: Portrait, from the upper rows of the south end zone stands looking straight down the length of the field to the north end and scoreboard, Nov 2013 UNC game, full crowd; field rows ~1300-2030 of 3200 (40-63%, upper-middle), far stands and scoreboard ~850-1300, cloudy blue sky in the top ~27%; stairway, railings and fans fill the bottom third
